title: SHE BOOKED
THE FLIGHT
summary: Pixie, Theo's online girlfriend of 2 years, booked a flight to meet him in 100 days. Everything he told her about himself is a lie.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.say: This is Theo. Twenty three. Still lives in his mom's basement. And for two years? He's had a girlfriend he has never seen!

scenes.speaker: narrator

texts.text: 100 days. i finally get to meet you

scenes.say: Her name is Pixie. They met in an online game. And this morning? She booked a flight!

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.say: One hundred days. Then she lands. And here's the problem. Theo told her he's six foot two! A firefighter! With abs! Plays guitar, speaks French, has his own apartment!

scenes.speaker: deb
scenes.say: Theo! Is that a girl? Is she real? Should I make a lasagna?

scenes.speaker: theo
scenes.say: Okay okay okay. A hundred days to make every lie true. I can't do this alone.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.say: So you decide! Top comment picks what Theo fixes tomorrow. Want to be in it? Comment who you'd be!
